definitions.explanation: A strong feeling of wanting something or wishing for something to happen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{願望|がんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{願望|がんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叶|かな}えるために→叶える：11807_kanaeru⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I work hard to fulfill my wishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{願望|がんぼう}⟦だった→だ：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Studying abroad was a long-held desire of mine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦への→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{願望|がんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has a strong desire for career advancement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦からの→から：00504_kara⟧{願望|がんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：noentry⟧⟦{叶|かな}って→叶える：11807_kanaeru⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦ことができた→こと：noentry⟧。
examples.english: My childhood wish finally came true, and I was able to open my own shop.

notes:
{願望|がんぼう} refers to a deep, heartfelt wish or desire — something one earnestly hopes for. It carries a more personal and emotional tone than ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {願望|がんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have a desire
- {願望|がんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叶|かな}える→叶える：11807_kanaeru⟧: to fulfill a wish
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{願望|がんぼう}: strong desire
- ⟦{潜在的|せんざいてき}→潜在的：14799_senzaiteki⟧{願望|がんぼう}: latent/subconscious desire
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{願望|がんぼう}: a long-held desire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧: hope, wish (more neutral and practical; used for requests and applications)
- ⟦{欲望|よくぼう}→欲望：05086_yokubou⟧: desire, lust (often negative; implies greed or excessive want)
- ⟦{望|のぞ}み→望み：03543_nozomi⟧: wish, desire (literary and poetic)
- ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧: wish, request (everyday; also used for prayers and formal requests)

REGISTER:
Slightly literary. More common in written language, psychology ({願望|がんぼう}⟦{充足|じゅうそく}→充足：21408_juusoku⟧ = wish fulfillment), and formal speech than in casual conversation.
